summary: Completed testing of new features: milk options, Adicionais tab, low stock system, and delete order functionality. All 15 backend tests passed. Frontend features verified working.
passed_tests: GET /api/admin/low-stock-list - Returns low stock items list
POST /api/admin/check-low-stock - Triggers manual low stock check
Kitchen delete removes order from both orders and history
Frontend: Milk options appear for items with 'leite', 'vitamina', 'shake' in name
Frontend: Café com Leite shows 4 milk options (Integral, Desnatado, Semi Desnatado, Zero Lactose)
Frontend: Vitamina shows milk options AND adicionais
Frontend: Shakes with milk show milk options
Frontend: Gestor Adicionais tab loads with 'Gerenciar Adicionais' and 'Novo Adicional' button
Frontend: Gestor Gráfico tab shows charts with Dia/Mês/Ano filters
Frontend: Gestor Gastos tab shows revenue vs expenses chart
Frontend: Kitchen page shows Vendas, Pedidos, Estoque tabs
Frontend: Kitchen Estoque shows '2 item(ns) com estoque baixo' warning
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed orders and adicionais created during testing (cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features verified working: 1) Milk options appear in ProductModal for items containing 'leite', 'vitamina', 'shake', 'cappuccino', 'café com leite', 'chocolate quente' in name/description. 2) Adicionais tab in Gestor panel allows CRUD operations. 3) Low stock system endpoints work - items with quantity <= 2 are tracked and can be sent to WhatsApp at 22:00. 4) Delete order endpoint permanently removes orders from both orders and order_history collections. 5) Kitchen page shows delete button (trash icon) for orders with status='ready'.

milk_options.details: Milk options (Integral, Desnatado, Semi Desnatado, Zero Lactose) appear for items with milk-related keywords. Options are free (price=0).

adicionais_tab.details: Gestor panel has Adicionais tab with CRUD functionality. Can create, edit, delete adicionais.

low_stock_system.details: GET /api/admin/low-stock-list returns items with quantity <= 2. POST /api/admin/check-low-stock triggers check. POST /api/admin/send-low-stock-report sends to WhatsApp.

delete_order.details: DELETE /api/orders/{store}/{order_id} permanently removes order from orders and order_history collections. Returns 404 for non-existent orders.

gestor_charts.details: Gráfico tab shows sales charts with Dia/Mês/Ano filters. Gastos tab shows revenue vs expenses chart.
